def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

lib_code = '''def components(cells):
    """The 4-connected components of a set of (row, col) cells, as lists of cells."""
    cells = set(cells); seen = set(); out = []
    for c in cells:
        if c in seen: continue
        stack = [c]; comp = set()
        while stack:
            p = stack.pop()
            if p in seen or p not in cells: continue
            seen.add(p); comp.add(p)
            r, cc = p
            stack += [(r + dr, cc + dc) for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))]
        out.append(comp)
    return out

def normalize(cells):
    """The bounding-box grid of a set of cells: 1 inside the shape, 0 outside."""
    rs = [r for r, _ in cells]; cs = [c for _, c in cells]
    r0, c0 = min(rs), min(cs)
    h = max(rs) - r0 + 1; w = max(cs) - c0 + 1
    return tuple(tuple(1 if (r0 + i, c0 + j) in cells else 0 for j in range(w)) for i in range(h))

def rotations(g):
    """The shape g and its 90-degree rotations, as tuples of tuples."""
    outs = [tuple(g)]
    for _ in range(3):
        g = [list(r) for r in zip(*g[::-1])]
        outs.append(tuple(tuple(r) for r in g))
    return set(outs)

def split_on_zero_column(grid):
    """The grid cut before its first all-zero column: (left part, right part)."""
    H = len(grid); W = len(grid[0])
    cut = min(j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i in range(H)))
    return [row[:cut] for row in grid], [row[cut:] for row in grid]

def enclosed_holes(grid, bg=0):
    """Components of bg cells in grid that do not touch the grid's border."""
    H = len(grid); W = len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for comp in components([(i, j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j] == bg]):
        if any(i == 0 or i == H - 1 or j == 0 or j == W - 1 for i, j in comp):
            continue
        out.append(comp)
    return out

def fill_holes_from_shapes(grid):
    """Fill each enclosed hole of the left subgrid with the color of the right subgrid shape whose silhouette matches it (allowing rotations)."""
    H = len(grid)
    left, right = split_on_zero_column(grid)
    cut = len(left[0])
    shapes = {}
    RW = len(right[0])
    for comp in components([(i, j) for i in range(H) for j in range(RW) if right[i][j] != 0]):
        any_cell = next(iter(comp))
        col = right[any_cell[0]][any_cell[1]]
        shapes[normalize(comp)] = col
    out = [row[:] for row in left]
    for hole in enclosed_holes(left):
        n = normalize(hole)
        col = shapes.get(n)
        if col is None:
            for s, c in shapes.items():
                if n in rotations(s):
                    col = c; break
        for i, j in hole:
            out[i][j] = col
    return out
'''
